extension.summary: Navega, reproduce y crea bibliotecas STRM desde remotes rclone
Browse, stream and build STRM libraries from rclone remotes
extension.description: Rclone Nexus permite navegar remotes crypt, combine y otros, reproducir mediante un servidor rclone local verificado y exportar carpetas como archivos STRM para la biblioteca de Kodi. Opcionalmente puede sincronizar el remote durante la reproducción con límites de CPU y llamadas; la indexación pesada de Kodi espera hasta finalizar el video.

Browse crypt, combine and other rclone remotes, stream through a verified local rclone server, and export folders as STRM files for the Kodi library. It can optionally synchronise remotes during playback with low CPU and API usage, deferring Kodi's heavier indexing stage until playback stops.
extension.news: 1.3.6: The interface now follows the Kodi language (English and Spanish included). Requires Kodi 21 (Omega) or newer. 1.3.5: Adds optional low-impact remote scans during playback. Scanner rclone processes use one Go CPU and one checker with provider calls limited to two per second; Kodi indexing is deferred until playback stops. Disabled by default.
